tables.name: person
tables.description: Human beings involved with AdventureWorks: employees, customer contacts, and vendor contacts.

tables.name: product
tables.description: Products sold or used in the manfacturing of sold products.

tables.name: customer
tables.description: Current customer information. Also see the Person and Store tables.

tables.name: salesorderdetail
tables.description: Individual products associated with a specific sales order. See SalesOrderHeader.

columns.name: businessentityid
columns.description: Primary key for Person records.

columns.name: persontype
columns.description: Primary type of person: SC = Store Contact, IN = Individual (retail) customer, SP = Sales person, EM = Employee (non-sales), VC = Vendor contact, GC = General contact

columns.name: namestyle
columns.description: 0 = The data in FirstName and LastName are stored in western style (first name, last name) order.  1 = Eastern style (last name, first name) order.

columns.name: title
columns.description: A courtesy title. For example, Mr. or Ms.

columns.name: firstname
columns.description: First name of the person.

columns.name: middlename
columns.description: Middle name or middle initial of the person.

columns.name: lastname
columns.description: Last name of the person.

columns.name: suffix
columns.description: Surname suffix. For example, Sr. or Jr.

columns.name: emailpromotion
columns.description: 0 = Contact does not wish to receive e-mail promotions, 1 = Contact does wish to receive e-mail promotions from AdventureWorks, 2 = Contact does wish to receive e-mail promotions from AdventureWorks and selected partners.

columns.name: additionalcontactinfo
columns.description: Additional contact information about the person stored in xml format.

columns.name: demographics
columns.description: Personal information such as hobbies, and income collected from online shoppers. Used for sales analysis.

columns.name: productid
columns.description: Primary key for Product records.

columns.name: name
columns.description: Name of the product.

columns.name: productnumber
columns.description: Unique product identification number.

columns.name: makeflag
columns.description: 0 = Product is purchased, 1 = Product is manufactured in-house.

columns.name: finishedgoodsflag
columns.description: 0 = Product is not a salable item. 1 = Product is salable.

columns.name: color
columns.description: Product color.

columns.name: safetystocklevel
columns.description: Minimum inventory quantity.

columns.name: reorderpoint
columns.description: Inventory level that triggers a purchase order or work order.

columns.name: standardcost
columns.description: Standard cost of the product.

columns.name: listprice
columns.description: Selling price.

columns.name: size
columns.description: Product size.

columns.name: sizeunitmeasurecode
columns.description: Unit of measure for Size column.

columns.name: weightunitmeasurecode
columns.description: Unit of measure for Weight column.

columns.name: weight
columns.description: Product weight.

columns.name: daystomanufacture
columns.description: Number of days required to manufacture the product.

columns.name: productline
columns.description: R = Road, M = Mountain, T = Touring, S = Standard

columns.name: class
columns.description: H = High, M = Medium, L = Low

columns.name: style
columns.description: W = Womens, M = Mens, U = Universal

columns.name: productsubcategoryid
columns.description: Product is a member of this product subcategory. Foreign key to ProductSubCategory.ProductSubCategoryID.

columns.name: productmodelid
columns.description: Product is a member of this product model. Foreign key to ProductModel.ProductModelID.

columns.name: sellstartdate
columns.description: Date the product was available for sale.

columns.name: sellenddate
columns.description: Date the product was no longer available for sale.

columns.name: discontinueddate
columns.description: Date the product was discontinued.

columns.name: productsubcategoryid
columns.description: Primary key for ProductSubcategory records.

columns.name: productcategoryid
columns.description: Product category identification number. Foreign key to ProductCategory.ProductCategoryID.

columns.name: name
columns.description: Subcategory description.

columns.name: transactionid
columns.description: Primary key for TransactionHistoryArchive records.

columns.name: productid
columns.description: Product identification number. Foreign key to Product.ProductID.

columns.name: referenceorderid
columns.description: Purchase order, sales order, or work order identification number.

columns.name: referenceorderlineid
columns.description: Line number associated with the purchase order, sales order, or work order.

columns.name: transactiondate
columns.description: Date and time of the transaction.

columns.name: transactiontype
columns.description: W = Work Order, S = Sales Order, P = Purchase Order

columns.name: quantity
columns.description: Product quantity.

columns.name: actualcost
columns.description: Product cost.

columns.name: customerid
columns.description: Primary key.

columns.name: personid
columns.description: Foreign key to Person.BusinessEntityID

columns.name: storeid
columns.description: Foreign key to Store.BusinessEntityID

columns.name: territoryid
columns.description: ID of the territory in which the customer is located. Foreign key to SalesTerritory.SalesTerritoryID.

columns.name: salesorderid
columns.description: Primary key. Foreign key to SalesOrderHeader.SalesOrderID.

columns.name: salesorderdetailid
columns.description: Primary key. One incremental unique number per product sold.

columns.name: carriertrackingnumber
columns.description: Shipment tracking number supplied by the shipper.

columns.name: orderqty
columns.description: Quantity ordered per product.

columns.name: productid
columns.description: Product sold to customer. Foreign key to Product.ProductID.

columns.name: specialofferid
columns.description: Promotional code. Foreign key to SpecialOffer.SpecialOfferID.

columns.name: unitprice
columns.description: Selling price of a single product.

columns.name: unitpricediscount
columns.description: Discount amount.

columns.name: salesorderid
columns.description: Primary key.

columns.name: revisionnumber
columns.description: Incremental number to track changes to the sales order over time.

columns.name: orderdate
columns.description: Dates the sales order was created.

columns.name: duedate
columns.description: Date the order is due to the customer.

columns.name: shipdate
columns.description: Date the order was shipped to the customer.

columns.name: status
columns.description: Order current status. 1 = In process; 2 = Approved; 3 = Backordered; 4 = Rejected; 5 = Shipped; 6 = Cancelled

columns.name: onlineorderflag
columns.description: 0 = Order placed by sales person. 1 = Order placed online by customer.

columns.name: purchaseordernumber
columns.description: Customer purchase order number reference.

columns.name: accountnumber
columns.description: Financial accounting number reference.

columns.name: customerid
columns.description: Customer identification number. Foreign key to Customer.BusinessEntityID.

columns.name: salespersonid
columns.description: Sales person who created the sales order. Foreign key to SalesPerson.BusinessEntityID.

columns.name: territoryid
columns.description: Territory in which the sale was made. Foreign key to SalesTerritory.SalesTerritoryID.

columns.name: billtoaddressid
columns.description: Customer billing address. Foreign key to Address.AddressID.

columns.name: shiptoaddressid
columns.description: Customer shipping address. Foreign key to Address.AddressID.

columns.name: shipmethodid
columns.description: Shipping method. Foreign key to ShipMethod.ShipMethodID.

columns.name: creditcardid
columns.description: Credit card identification number. Foreign key to CreditCard.CreditCardID.

columns.name: creditcardapprovalcode
columns.description: Approval code provided by the credit card company.

columns.name: currencyrateid
columns.description: Currency exchange rate used. Foreign key to CurrencyRate.CurrencyRateID.

columns.name: subtotal
columns.description: Sales subtotal. Computed as SUM(SalesOrderDetail.LineTotal)for the appropriate SalesOrderID.

columns.name: taxamt
columns.description: Tax amount.

columns.name: freight
columns.description: Shipping cost.

columns.name: totaldue
columns.description: Total due from customer. Computed as Subtotal + TaxAmt + Freight.

columns.name: comment
columns.description: Sales representative comments.
